test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In 2016, the price of a refrigerator increased by 5%, and in 2017, it decreased by 5%. At the end of the year 2017, its price was ₹47,880. What was its price at the beginning of the year 2016?
solution:
**Given:**

Price at the end of 2017 = ₹47,880

Price increase in 2016 = 5%

Price decrease in 2017 = 5%

Calculation:

Let the price at the beginning of 2016 be ₹P.

Price after 5% increase in 2016 = P × 1.05

Price after 5% decrease in 2017 = (P × 1.05) × 0.95

Given that the price at the end of 2017 is ₹47,880:

(P × 1.05) × 0.95 = 47,880

⇒ P × 1.05 × 0.95 = 47,880

⇒ P × 0.9975 = 47,880

⇒ P = 47,880 / 0.9975

⇒ P = 48,000

**∴ The price at the beginning of the year 2016 was ₹48,000.**
